text:
melissa_cs: Heads-up — AcmeCorp exec QBR next Wed 11am PT. Need final slide owners, demo owner, and the renewal ask.
melissa_cs: Deck: https://redwood.slides/acme-acmecorp-qbr-v3 — please add time-coded notes and owner initials on each slide.
jordan_csm: I can own slides 1–3 (health + adoption). Can we put the renewal ask on slide 2 so execs see it early?
rahul_success: I'll own the renewal ask + one-pager for execs. Will draft numbers by Tue EOD.
olivia_eng: I can run the live demo. Need someone to own infra fallback (recorded clip or static gif) if live fails.
melissa_cs: @olivia_eng perfect — please prepare a 30s fallback clip. @jordan_csm can you confirm which success metrics to highlight?
jordan_csm: Metrics: DAU +18% MoM, activation rate 42%, latency SLO 99.9%. Adding small chart on slide 3.
dan_sales: Looping in exec alignment — I want to propose a 12-month reserved Dedicated plan as the primary ask. Need projected spend and 3 ROI bullets.
rahul_success: Drafting ROI bullets now: (1) 25% lower per-token cost with batching, (2) predicted cost savings vs current infra, (3) estimated uplift in conversion. Will add numbers to slide 2.
melissa_cs: Action checklist: melissa assign owners in deck, rahul draft ask + 1-pager, jordan metrics + charts, olivia demo + fallback, dan exec signoff and pricing bullets. Please add notes in the deck by Tue 3pm PT.
jordan_csm: Done — I added speaker notes on slides 2–4 and attached a screenshot for the metric chart.
melissa_cs: Reviewing now. Left comments on slide 2 — tighten ROI language and add explicit next-step (pilot -> commit). Also flagged two renewal risks: price sensitivity and SSO gap for Legal.
dan_sales: Noted. I'll prepare rebuttals + alternative pricing options. Is it OK to surface SSO as a potential ask for Private deployment?
olivia_eng: ETA for SSO fix if prioritized is ~6 weeks. I can prepare a mitigation plan to present (temporary SSO workaround + rollout ETA).
calendar-bot: Event created: AcmeCorp QBR — Wed 11:00am PT — Attendees: melissa_cs, jordan_csm, rahul_success, olivia_eng, dan_sales
jordan_csm: LGTM :thumbsup:
rahul_success: I'll circulate the final 1-pager and slide PDF by Wed morning.
melissa_cs: Thanks — quick pre-slate runthrough Tue 4pm PT. Please RSVP and upload your final assets before noon tomorrow.
melissa_cs: Quick reference (copy into deck notes):
```
Slide ownership:
  S1: jordan_csm (health)
  S2: rahul_success (renewal ask + ROI)
  S3: jordan_csm (metrics + adoption)
  S4: olivia_eng (demo + fallback)
  S5: dan_sales (pricing + exec ask)
```
melissa_cs: Ping me if anything blocks — want the deck locked by Tue 5pm so we can rehearse with execs on Wed AM.
